_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: a GameCube project is one game (a disc image or a homebrew executable), and whatever the machine is to start with already written on its card. No firmware appears here - a GameCube boots without any dump (the IPL is emulated in software and the free DSP roms ship inside this package).

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The disc image (.iso/.gcm, or dolphin's own .rvz), or a homebrew executable (.dol/.elf) booted directly the way a modded console would.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the machine starts with already saved - put back exactly what Emulator > Export Save Data... wrote, so a run can continue from where another left off. It is mounted read-only and pinned by hash, and the movie cites it. GameCube: the raw memory card image, under the same name (MemoryCardA.USA.raw, .EUR., or .JAP. following the game's region); leave it empty and the machine formats a blank card at boot. Wii: the .zip Export Save Data writes (its files are nand/title/.../data/..., the game's own saves from the console's NAND); they go into the game's save directory before it starts. A save of a different game is refused rather than ignored.
